name: monity-ai
description: Watch any web page and see what changed: scheduled checks in a cloud browser, a full-page screenshot and full HTML copy of every check, and before/after evidence in the conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Track changes on any web page directly in chat. Ask monity.ai to watch a page, say what matters to you, and get an alert when it happens.

monity.ai checks each page on a schedule in its own cloud browser. Every check keeps a full-page screenshot and a full HTML copy of the page, so you see exactly what changed right in the conversation: a before/after slider, the highlighted difference, the value before and now, and a short summary. If a check reached a captcha or a login wall instead of the page, it tells you instead of reporting a change.

Use it for prices and restocks, competitor pages, job listings, release notes, policy pages and status pages.

Try a conversation like this:
- Watch this product page and tell me when the price drops below $500
- What changed on the pages I watch this week?
- Show me what changed on my competitor's pricing page
- Pause all my monitors labelled "news"

For more control, open monity.ai to set up page actions, logins, notification channels and check frequency.
defaultPrompt: What changed on the pages I watch this week?
Tell me when this product is back in stock in size M
Watch a competitor's pricing page and tell me when it changes
